notes: This site uses a third-party Tupelo marketplace widget (organization ID: cm4xn1drl0000dhxtcem9cls1) that renders listings dynamically via JavaScript. The HTML contains only <tupelo-marketplace> web component with no actual listing data. REQUIRES JavaScript rendering with Playwright/Selenium to extract listings. The widget may load data from an API endpoint that could potentially be reverse-engineered for direct API access. Alternative approach: investigate network requests to find the Tupelo API endpoint being called.
